reference.configuration: Contemporary early Edgar Quinet-class arrangement: six funnels in two groups of three, twin 194 mm turrets at the ends, six single wing turrets and four casemate 194 mm guns. The 1909 source incorrectly labels some calibers as 6.4 inches and 3 inches; preserve those annotations as historical source evidence, not catalog specifications. The fourteen main-gun stations and six-funnel hull are the matching recognition features.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
